_comment: Feature flag reference document — source of truth for flag names, defaults, and structure.

rules: Suffix with _v<N> when replacing an existing flow (enables gradual rollout)
Boolean flags: enabled true/false + variants + traffic_split
Retire flag + legacy code path once variant_a hits 100% traffic

_environments.EDGE_CONFIG: Set in Vercel / Cloudflare / Supabase vault per environment
_environments.fallback: If EDGE_CONFIG is unavailable, all flags default to enabled:false (safe default)

onboarding_flow_v2.description: New onboarding flow with progress bar and inline validation. variant_a = new flow, control = current flow.

hr_policy_assistant_v2.description: Redesigned HR policy assistant with streaming responses and source citations.

employee_dashboard_v2.description: Platform V2 employee dashboard. variant_a = new card-based layout.
